Standard: Ship-based air vehicle mooring provisions demonstrate damage free operation of the landing gear, air vehicle, and surrounding structure for all operational conditions such as heavy weather, deck pitch, roll, and design wind speed. The placement of mooring provisions ensures full capability to extend, retract, and store the landing gear. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Review mooring locations and patterns to verify compatibility with deck fitting positions and positioning of restraints does not damage or interfere with the landing gear operation. Analysis.
  (1) Conduct a loads analysis to define limit and ultimate loads envelope needed to secure the air vehicle.
  (2) Conduct static strength analysis to verify mooring provisions and supporting landing gear structure can sustain limit and ultimate loads. Permanent deformations do not occur at DLL. Gross section yielding or detrimental deformations do not occur at or below 115% DLL. No rupture, buckling, or collapsing failures occur at or below ultimate load. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Demonstration.
    (1) Conduct a ground demonstration to verify the location of mooring provisions allow for tie down to ship deck fittings and no damage to air vehicle.
